name: Cinematic Graphic Novel
description: Confident ink contours, expressive adult faces and strong graphic shadow shapes.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one Cinematic Graphic Novel visual-treatment example for a story-film style chooser.
Primary request: create a polished original full-frame inked graphic-novel movie still. The storytelling and expressions must read as clearly as a cinematic two-shot.

Style/medium: elegant hand-inked graphic novel illustration across BOTH characters and the whole environment. Confident varied-weight dark contours, beautifully designed solid shadow masses, restrained fine crosshatching and sparse subtle printed halftone only within selected shadow areas. Strong readable silhouettes and expressive adult faces, with believable simplified anatomy and natural hands. Graphic, selective detail rather than photographic surface texture. Distinct from anime, a soft painted storybook, a rounded cartoon or a glossy 3D render. Design the station, bench and hills with the same controlled ink language. Rich clean spot colors with deliberate unprinted cream areas. Refined, inviting and emotionally warm, rather than grimy, scratchy or aggressively posterized.

Scene/backdrop: a quiet fictional countryside railway platform in soft late-afternoon daylight. A cream plaster station with sage-green window trim and a simple timber canopy recedes into the background. One wooden bench at right and green hills beyond. Spacious uncluttered setting, no crowds, train or signage.
Subject/story moment: a young adult woman has come home and offers her elderly father one small plain cream envelope. She stands left facing right; he sits on the bench at right facing her. Warm, restrained, relieved smiles and clear mutual eyelines. She has warm medium-brown skin, a short wavy dark bob, an indigo jacket over an ivory shirt, muted terracotta scarf, dark trousers and brown boots. He has warm medium-brown skin, short silver hair, an olive cardigan over a cream shirt and charcoal trousers. She holds the envelope naturally at waist height, keeping its shape clearly readable; his hands rest comfortably on his knees. Exactly two people and one envelope. No complicated finger gestures.
Composition/framing: single wide landscape cinematic frame, approximately 16:9, medium-wide eye-level two-shot. Full standing figure including boots and full seated figure including feet, comfortable margins and natural perspective. Faces large enough to read, subjects clearly separated from architectural lines and shaded background. Coherent receding canopy, bench, platform and rails. Calm foreground near the bottom.
Lighting/color: directional late-afternoon light translated into bold ink shadow shapes; readable faces and controlled contrast. Restrained warm ivory, sage green, indigo and terracotta, with subtle cooler distant hills and deep charcoal inks. Preserve warmth without an orange wash. No neon, muddy shadows, excessive bloom or flat gray skin.
Constraints: one finished scene only. No comic panels, borders, lettering, dialogue balloons, captions, sound-effect words, logos, watermark or interface. Do not imitate a named artist, franchise or studio. No extra limbs, distorted hands, cropped feet or floating envelope. This is optional global visual-treatment inspiration, not a particular film's canon.
review_notes: Inspected actual generated output: varied ink contours and selective hatching across adult faces, clothes and architecture; strong shadow masses and restrained spot colors, clearly distinct from the anime/cartoon/painterly samples. Readable mutual eyelines, relaxed expressions, natural envelope hold and resting hands, full figures/feet inside frame, coherent receding station and bench. No unwanted text, panel borders or conspicuous anatomy defects at reviewed scale. The father's hands rest together near his knees, and a shoulder bag is an illustrative variation. Not a canonical continuity sheet or a claim of exact prompt compliance.
source_filename_role: Actual built-in tool result, copied unchanged into the workspace; original retained in the generated-images folder.

selection_basis.source: Current user message selecting the proposed global style.
selection_basis.scope: Create and include the Cinematic Graphic Novel example in the global style chooser.
